Common.name: Airknight Parshath
Common.desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

Common.name: Archlord Kristya
Common.desc: If you have exactly 4 Fairy monsters in your GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If Summoned this way: Target 1 Fairy monster in your GY; add that target to your hand. Neither player can Special Summon monsters. If this face-up card would be sent from the field to the GY, place it on top of the Deck, instead.

Common.name: Athena
Common.desc: If another Fairy monster(s) is Summoned: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent. Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up Fairy monster you control to the GY, except "Athena", then target 1 Fairy monster in your GY, except "Athena"; Special Summon that target.

Common.name: Bountiful Artemis
Common.desc: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, draw 1 card.

Common.name: Cards from the Sky
Common.desc: Banish 1 LIGHT Fairy monster in your hand, and if you do, draw 2 cards. You cannot Special Summon or conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

Common.name: Celestial Transformation
Common.desc: Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your hand. That monster's ATK is halved, also it is destroyed during the End Phase.

Common.name: D.D. Sprite
Common.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 face-up monster you control. If you Summon this way, during your next Standby Phase: Return the banished monster to the field.

Common.name: Dark Bribe
Common.desc: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card: Your opponent draws 1 card, also negate the Spell/Trap activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Divine Punishment
Common.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated, while "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Drastic Drop Off
Common.desc: When your opponent adds a card(s) from their Deck to their hand, including drawing: They must discard 1 of those cards.

Common.name: Gellenduo
Common.desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle. If you take any damage: Destroy this face-up card. This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT Fairy monster.

Common.name: Guiding Ariadne
Common.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
Apply these effects.
● You do not pay LP to activate Counter Trap Cards.
● You do not discard to activate Counter Trap Cards.

[ Monster Effect ] 
If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can reveal 3 Counter Traps from your Deck, your opponent chooses 1 for you to add to your hand, and you shuffle the rest back into your Deck.

Common.name: Guiding Light
Common.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 1 LIGHT monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

Common.name: Hanewata
Common.desc: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; you take no effect damage this turn.

Common.name: Harvest Angel of Wisdom
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can target 1 Counter Trap in your GY; add it to your hand.

Common.name: Hecatrice
Common.desc: You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen" from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Herald of Green Light
Common.desc: When your opponent activates a Spell Card (Quick Effect): You can send this card and 1 other Fairy monster from your hand to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Herald of Orange Light
Common.desc: When your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can send this card and 1 other Fairy monster from your hand to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Herald of Purple Light
Common.desc: When your opponent activates a Trap Card (Quick Effect): You can send this card and 1 other Fairy monster from your hand to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Honest
Common.desc: During your Main Phase: You can return this face-up card from the field to the hand. During the Damage Step, when a LIGHT monster you control battles (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; that monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling, until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Layard the Liberator
Common.desc: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, add 2 of your banished Fairy monsters to your hand.

Common.name: Light of Judgment
Common.desc:
If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field: Discard 1 LIGHT monster to the GY; apply 1 of the following effects.
● Look at your opponent's hand and discard 1 card from their hand.
● Send 1 card your opponent controls to the GY.

Common.name: Meltiel, Sage of the Sky
Common.desc: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, gain 1000 LP, and if you do, if "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field, destroy 1 card your opponent controls.

Common.name: Minerva, Scholar of the Sky
Common.desc: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, this card gains 500 ATK, and if it does, and "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field, add 1 Counter Trap with a different name from your GY to your hand.

Common.name: Miraculous Descent
Common.desc: Target 1 of your banished Fairy monsters; Special Summon it. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

Common.name: Neo-Parshath, the Sky Paladin
Common.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Airknight Parshath". If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card. While "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field and your LP is higher than your opponent's, this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the difference in LP.

Common.name: Nova Summoner
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Fairy monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field, you can Special Summon 1 "Airknight Parshath" instead.

Common.name: Recall
Common.desc: When your opponent activates a monster effect: Your opponent draws 1 card, also negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Solemn Warning
Common.desc: When a monster(s) would be Summoned, OR when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that includes an effect that Special Summons a monster(s): Pay 2000 LP; negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Splendid Venus
Common.desc: All non-Fairy monsters lose 500 ATK/DEF. The activation and effects of Spell/Trap Cards activated on your field cannot be negated.

Common.name: Synthetic Seraphim
Common.desc: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, Special Summon 1 "Synthetic Seraphim Token" (Fairy/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 300).

Common.name: Synthetic Seraphim Token
Common.desc:
This card can be used as a "Synthetic Seraphim Token".


*If used for another Token, apply that Token's Type/Attribute/Level/ATK/DEF.

Common.name: Tethys, Goddess of Light
Common.desc: When you draw a Fairy monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can reveal 1 of those monsters; draw 1 card. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

Common.name: The Sanctuary in the Sky
Common.desc: Battle damage to the controller of a Fairy monster from a battle involving that monster becomes 0.

Common.name: Ties of the Brethren
Common.desc: Pay 2000 LP, then target 1 Level 4 or lower monster you control; for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters, also Special Summon 2 monsters from your Deck, with the same Type, Attribute, and Level as that monster, but with different names from each other and that monster. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

Common.name: Ultimate Providence
Common.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated: Discard the same type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

Ultra Rare.name: Eva
Ultra Rare.desc: If this card is sent to the GY: You can banish up to 2 other LIGHT Fairy monsters from your field and/or GY; add the same number of Level 2 or lower LIGHT Fairy monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand, except "Eva". You can only use this effect of "Eva" once per turn.

Ultra Rare.name: Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath
Ultra Rare.desc: If you activate a Counter Trap Card, OR if you negate the activation of a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect (except during the Damage Step): You can banish 2 other Fairy monsters from your hand, field and/or GY; Special Summon this card from the GY (if it was there when you activated/negated) or hand (even if not). If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can add 1 "Parshath" card or 1 Counter Trap from your Deck to your hand.

Super Rare.name: Power Angel Valkyria
Super Rare.desc: If you negate the activation of a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect: Add 1 LIGHT Fairy monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Power Angel Valkyria" once per turn.

Super Rare.name: Rebirth of Parshath
Super Rare.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated: Reveal 1 Counter Trap in your hand, then discard 1 card and pay 1000 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, shuffle that card into the Deck. Then, you can Special Summon 1 "Parshath" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck.

Super Rare.name: The Sanctum of Parshath
Super Rare.desc: This card's name becomes "The Sanctuary in the Sky" while on the field or in the GY. Fairy monsters on the field gain 300 ATK/DEF. Set Spells/Traps cannot be targeted by, or destroyed by, card effects. Once per turn: You can target a total of 3 Fairy monsters and/or Counter Traps with different names in your GY; place them on top of your Deck in any order.
